questions.q: In this course, which software is "the Application" that the API gives access to?
questions.explain: This course is about Oracle Fusion Financials' REST APIs specifically.

questions.q: What does the request body schema on a documentation page tell you?
options: The visual theme of the Oracle Fusion UI
Which fields a POST or PATCH operation accepts, and which are required
How many users are logged in
questions.explain: The request body schema lists every field the operation accepts and flags which are required.

questions.q: A GET request to /invoices/300000182 and a PATCH request to the same URL target the same resource. What's different?
options: Nothing — they do the exact same thing
GET reads the invoice without changing it; PATCH updates part of it
GET deletes the invoice; PATCH creates a new one
PATCH can only be used on collections, never single resources
questions.explain: The URL stays the same; the method determines whether it's a read or an update.

options: A protocol that requires a persistent connection between client and server
An architectural style for designing APIs around resources, not a product or protocol
A file format Oracle Fusion stores data in
questions.explain: REST is a set of design conventions, described by Roy Fielding, not a protocol or product.

questions.q: What is a REST client primarily used for?
options: Building, sending, and inspecting HTTP requests directly, without code
questions.explain: A REST client is a tool for directly testing HTTP requests.

questions.q: What does "fscmRestApi" stand for in an Oracle Fusion REST URL?
options: Financials and Supply Chain Management REST API
questions.explain: fscmRestApi is the shared REST root for Financials and Supply Chain Management.

questions.q: Which parameter works like a SQL 'where clause' to filter a collection?
questions.explain: q is the filter expression parameter, similar to a where clause.

questions.q: What does the Accept: application/json header do on a request to Oracle Fusion's REST API?
options: It tells Fusion to respond in JSON format
It is required only for DELETE requests
questions.explain: The Accept header tells the server what response format the caller wants.

questions.q: What actually protects a Basic Authentication header in transit?
questions.explain: HTTPS, not base64, is what actually protects the credentials in transit.

questions.q: What is a concrete risk of using a personal employee login for an integration?
options: The integration breaks if that employee's password is reset or they leave the company
There is no risk at all
questions.explain: A personal-login dependency breaks when that individual's account changes.

questions.q: A request has valid credentials but the user lacks permission for that specific business unit. What kind of failure is this?
questions.explain: Valid credentials means authentication succeeded; being denied access is an authorization issue.

options: Retrying a failed call instantly, as many times as possible
Waiting progressively longer between each retry attempt
Giving up after the first failure, always
A method for encrypting API credentials
questions.explain: Exponential backoff means increasing the wait time between retries.

questions.q: Which course does this catalog's REST APIs and Integration Fundamentals course lead into next?
questions.explain: Per the Oracle Fusion Financials Consultant path's stage order, Oracle Fusion Security is next.

questions.q: What are the three parts of a typical OIC integration flow, in order?
questions.explain: An OIC flow starts with a trigger, maps data via transform, then delivers it.

questions.q: Which of the four questions is NOT one used to decide an integration pattern in this lesson?
questions.explain: Volume, latency, direction, and frequency are the four deciding questions — not formatting.

questions.q: Where is a business event turned on for a given Financials module?
options: It's always on by default for every module
An "Enable Business Events" profile option in Setup and Maintenance, set per module
By editing a REST request header
It cannot be turned on at all
questions.explain: Business events are enabled per module via a Setup and Maintenance profile option.
